case_classification.short_description: Very complex debt waterfall model (Mother of all debt waterfall models) - quarterly model including interest conventions and additional annual overview

ai_time_estimate_reasoning: This is an exceptionally complex debt waterfall modeling task that requires building a quarterly model spanning 20 years (80 quarters) with 14 distinct waterfall steps. An expert modeler must handle multiple day-count (Act/360, 30/360, Act/Act) and interest quoting conventions (Nominal vs. EAR), track rolling/carried-forward unpaid scheduled repayments for six tranches of senior debt, manage subordinated debt capitalization, model interest-to-equity conversions for convertible debt, and implement intricate equity distribution rules. The equity rules require calculating dividend payouts across five share classes while dynamically tracking vesting periods and multi-year holding periods for converted shares. Building, auditing, and checking this highly detailed model against the 40 specific validation questions on the Questions tab will easily require 4 hours of focused, expert-level modeling.
